rationale: The renderer choice is still open and changes the file list: the Node option adds a devDependency tree and lockfile under scripts/pdf/, while the dependency-free Chrome option adds none, so the unresolved question alone earns deep. Domains are empty because the rendered input is the student's own trusted Markdown and no gate, credential, or permission changes.

signals.blast_radius: One new build script, its stylesheet, a possible lockfile, README and .gitignore edits, and about 26 generated PDFs. All edits are additive and no existing script, Maven module or marking code changes.
signals.unresolved: Which renderer to use (Node marked/highlight.js with puppeteer-core versus dependency-free Chrome --print-to-pdf) changes whether a package.json and lockfile are added. Whether PAPER.md has content to hold back is a smaller question.
signals.irreversibility: Low. The PDFs are generated outputs that git revert removes cleanly, though the committed PDFs and the PR are a shared artefact once pushed. The main correctness risk is a hint or answer leaking into LESSON.pdf, which verify must check.
